name: conditional-reflex-audit-v1
question: When the target is staggered and another foe nearby is attacking, does I2-memory change reflex / face_first into stagger_punish across runs (not only 20261019_212954)?
kind: descriptive recount of stored predictions; no training, no prediction, no input change

A_target_staggered.field: tick.a (target anim at capture, equals the target char's anim)

B_other_attacking_lt_2_5m.definition: any snap.chars c with c.ptr != tick.ptr, c.team in {6,7,24,25,27,33}, c.hp > 0, c.anim in range(3000, 3500), hypot(c.x - player.x, c.z - player.z) < 2.5
B_other_attacking_lt_2_5m.sources: teams/hp: telemetry.Snapshot.hostile (telemetry.py:117-118); attack: souls/moves.py:24 ATTACK; 2.5 m = reflex THREAT_R (souls/reflex.py:31)
B_other_attacking_lt_2_5m.fields: snap.chars[].ptr, team, hp, anim, x, z; snap.player.x, z; tick.ptr
B_other_attacking_lt_2_5m.meaning: an observed snapshot state only — not 'the reflex rule fired' and not 'the attack hit'

conditions.note: scene chars are those captured within 25 m (scenes.CHAR_R); the player is not in snap.chars

metric_note: recall here = correct / scenes of that true class within the condition cell; this is not overall precision or macro F1

transitions.raw: y_true|y_pred_i1|y_pred_i2 with every predicted rule kept
transitions.display: predicted rules outside the 3 classes shown as 'other' (raw kept alongside)

per_run: core cell (A and B) per run: true-class counts, I1/I2 correct, transitions
limits: I1 already has nearby-foe counts/distances and n_other_attacking_4m; this 2.5 m split is an audit stratification, not a model feature
cannot separate target-centred memory, representation, RF max_features sampling, or version effects
